supersedes_nomenclature: Continuous-video/ego-clock assumptions in the temporal proposal are not established. Evaluate verified distinct observations as offline episodic multiview, not chronological or causal online adaptation.
availability_evidence: Root reports avis audit of all5912 target metadata found repeated/reset/nonmonotonic timestamps; frame folders are not a valid temporal clock. This reviewer has not independently reopened those metadata containers; bind the eventual input-audit receipt before final execution/report.

primary_registration.input: Actual RGB/depth/LiDAR correspondences plus audited same-observation camera calibration, independent of targetGT and q0-seeded masks.
primary_registration.estimate: Explicit RGBD/SIFT geometric estimate from real observations, fixed settings and predeclared acceptance, no providedpose initialization or hypothesis/neighbor selection.
primary_registration.provided_pose: Unknown-provenance dataset4x4 is diagnostic only; never initialize, select, tune, reject, or choose the primary estimate using it. A separately labelled pose-oracle auxiliary would need its own authorization and cannot pass the primary prerequisite.
primary_registration.validation: Report inlier/support coverage, independent held-out feature/point consistency where feasible, forward/reverse or cycle agreement, ambiguity/degeneracy and actual units/coordinate transforms. Low residual on fit correspondences alone is not independent validation.
primary_registration.motion: Static-world transform validity and moving-instance correspondence are separate. A global rigid transform does not compensate dynamic pedestrians/vehicles. Unknown/multiple motion or inconsistent object correspondence rejects that support instead of silently fusing it.
primary_registration.claim: Success supports geometric overlap between observations only; it does not establish a timestamp order, complete ego trajectory, same-object identity or target correctness.

mask_correspondence.generation: Whole-image independent instance masks from frozenCOCO helper, no q0/caption/GT API. COCO taxonomic/domain limitations remain visible.
mask_correspondence.association: Fullcaption/independent instance evidence and conservative one-to-one correspondence, with ambiguous competing instances retained/rejected. Mask similarity/objectness/class overlap cannot be translated to verified target identity.
mask_correspondence.geometry: Project matched observations using estimated transform and occlusion/depth visibility. Preserve direction/source prior assumptions and percoordinate origin. No extent-as-amodal-size shortcut.
mask_correspondence.q0: Preferred fixedquery protocol. If the new method changes query/target association, add association-only no-geometry control before freezing arms and keep q0/q1 separate.

minimal_branch_comparisons: same G with independent single-observation instance evidence
same G with accepted estimated-geometry multiview instance correspondence
fixed wrong-observation or shuffled correspondence, same source and helper budget
prelocked simple attenuation/sourceprior comparator once actual G is specified
denominators: All preselected anchors retained with sourcefallback; registration-available, accepted-static, moving-reject, ambiguous, missing and numerical-failure counts explicit. Same presealed common eligibility/change masks for matched comparisons. Support observations are not new test anchors/scenes.
progression: First direct-supervision task and relevant-coordinate benefit over source and genericattenuation in bothplatforms. Multiview-specific gain additionally requires positive multiview-minus-singleframe incremental evidence and correspondence controls. Only2/3sceneclusters, descriptive resource gate not population significance. No new neuralupdate stage without unused-observation transfer and same-information direct/kernel controls.
if_no_registration_support: Mark multiview branch missing/unidentifiable. Lock only bounded single-observation independent-mask diagnostic, without claiming temporal support.
